user.title: Connect to FumboClient
user.description: Enable the local server in Minecraft under H → Settings → Home Assistant. For another HA device enable LAN access. Enter the Minecraft PC's LAN IP, not the Home Assistant address. No MQTT broker required.

reconfigure.title: Update client connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the address and current pairing token for the same client installation.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair FumboClient again
reauth_confirm.description: Copy the current token from the Minecraft client. Check its optional allowed-HA-IP setting.

error.cannot_connect: Client unavailable. Check Minecraft, LAN access, IP, port and firewall.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid token or HA IP not allowed by the client.
error.invalid_input: Use a local IP, port 1024–65535 and the 64-character pairing token.
error.invalid_response: Not a compatible FumboClient local API (version 1).

abort.already_configured: This client installation is already configured.
abort.wrong_device: This is a different client installation. Add it separately.

init.title: Polling
init.description: Refresh shared client state every 2–30 seconds. Permissions are configured in Minecraft.
